description: This file contains shell functions used during the system initialization process (preinit stage) for OpenWrt. It provides hooks, pivoting, and overlay setup functions to modify the root filesystem during boot.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_start
methods.description: Initializes the PI_HOOK_SPLICE variable to start the hook splice process.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the hook splice process, processing and exporting multiple hook functions.

methods.name: boot_hook_init
methods.description: Initializes a specific hook list for a given stage or event.

methods.name: boot_hook_add
methods.description: Adds a function to a specified hook list, enabling multiple functions to be called sequentially.

methods.name: boot_hook_shift
methods.description: Removes the first function from a hook list and returns it.

methods.name: boot_run_hook
methods.description: Executes all functions registered in a specified hook.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs a pivot root operation, moving the root filesystem during boot.

methods.name: fopivot
methods.description: Sets up an overlay filesystem and then pivots to it.

methods.name: ramoverlay
methods.description: Creates an in-memory overlay filesystem on /tmp/root with overlayfs and pivots to it.
